title: A query that collides with an unrelated capability on one shared word
rationale: A near-miss is worse than no answer, because the agent uses it. If this fails, the registry actively degrades the work.
recordedFrom: An ordinary session, 2026-09-12. CFCM answered MATCH at 0.5679 for CapFoundry.geo.distance — a geographic capability for a string problem — because the word "distance" appeared in its name, aliases, description, summaries and example queries at once. The agent rejected it and wrote the code. Recorded as F5 in the PRD; the confidence formula was fixed, and this scenario is the regression guard.
